concepts.name: The little knot
concepts.prompt_summary: A broad apricot ribbon folded into a compact t-like knot, paired with a humanist sans-serif Threadly wordmark. Flat cream identity board with monochrome and reversed symbols.

concepts.name: In the margins
concepts.prompt_summary: Two offset bracket-like strokes interlock into a compact conversation monogram, with a citron connection point and a precise sans-serif Threadly wordmark. Flat paper identity board with monochrome and reversed symbols.

concepts.name: Woven together
concepts.prompt_summary: Two broad rounded strips woven once into a soft T with a negative-space crossing, paired with a friendly contemporary serif Threadly wordmark. Flat oat identity board with monochrome and reversed symbols.
